make -C ../lib CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1 " liblz4.a
make[1]: Entering directory '/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/lib'
compiling static library
make[1]: Leaving directory '/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/lib'
gcc -c -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1   -I../lib -DXXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_ compress_fuzzer.c -o compress_fuzzer.o
# Compile the standalone code just in case. The OSS-Fuzz code might
# override the LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE value to "-fsanitize=fuzzer"
gcc -c -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1   -I../lib -DXXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_ standaloneengine.c -o standaloneengine.o
# Now compile the actual fuzzer.
g++ -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -g -DLZ4_DEBUG=1   -I../lib -DXXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_ -fsanitize=address standaloneengine.o compress_fuzzer.o ../lib/liblz4.a -o compress_fuzzer
rm compress_fuzzer.o
